name: What is the process for upgrading kitchen sink plumbing?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for upgrading kitchen sink plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading kitchen sink plumbing typically involves disconnecting the old sink and faucet, inspecting and potentially updating the supply lines and drain pipes, installing the new sink basin, and then connecting the new faucet and garbage disposal if applicable. This process may also include modifying the countertop opening if changing sink sizes. Our team at Frasheski Construction will coordinate all aspects, including any necessary cabinet adjustments or countertop modifications, ensuring a seamless integration with your existing kitchen design.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes disconnecting old fixtures, inspecting existing plumbing, installing the new sink and faucet, and potentially modifying the countertop. We manage all integration aspects.
